channel.title: Lawn & Landscape Magazine - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Lawn & Landscape Magazine (lawnandlandscape.com)

item.title: Moneypenny earns status as ServiceTitan Certified Provider
item.description: To qualify, a significant proportion of Moneypenny’s receptionists handling calls must be fully ServiceTitan certified and trained on the platform.

item.title: Advanced Turf Solutions adds Chaffee as fertilizer market specialist
item.description: Scott Chaffee will lead ATS’ granular fertilizer strategy and manage relationships with vendor partners.

item.title: Husqvarna makes key leadership changes across the company
item.description: Yvette Henshall-Bell and Omar Attar earned new roles with the company while CFO Terry Burke and Construction Division President Karin Falk plan company departures.

item.title: WorkWave rolls out Wavelytics Decision Intelligence
item.description: The new AI-powered hub that embeds dynamic dashboards directly into WorkWave’s core software solutions.

item.title: Reinhart Landscaping & Snow, Kress donate electric landscape equipment to Heartland Community College
item.description: The Kress electric commercial equipment will allow students to train with the same technology currently being used by landscape professionals.

item.title: Schill Grounds Management acquires Brogan Landscaping
item.description: The acquisition adds two new branches to Schill’s growing Mid-Atlantic footprint.

item.title: Equip Expo to start two-city rotation in 2029
item.description: The annual trade show will be in Orlando in 2029, 2031 and 2033, but will remain in Louisville in 2030 and 2032.

item.title: Stihl President, CEO Chris Keffer leaves the company
item.description: Stihl's Lorraine Amesbury Holder and Uwe Hirsch will assume responsibility for overseeing the president’s duties.

item.title: Our coverage from the NALP Leaders Forum
item.description: We're live from California with updates from the annual event.

item.title: SpringGreen hosts National Advisory Council meeting
item.description: During the meeting, participants reviewed system updates, discussed opportunities for improvement and shared insights from their local markets.
